description: Re-point an existing short link at a new destination, or change its title, description or UTM parameters. This is what makes a printed QR code reusable: the code encodes the short link, so changing the destination redirects every copy already printed, shared or stuck on a wall, and the click history is kept. The new destination is screened with Google Safe Browsing. The short code itself never changes here, because changing it would break every copy already out there. Requires a ShareCut API key (Business plan).

link.description: The link, given either as its short code (the part after sharecut.site/) or as the id returned when it was created. A full ShareCut URL is accepted too.

title.description: New label for the owner dashboard.

url.description: The new http(s) destination. Short links only — a menu or link-in-bio page has no single destination.

utm.description: UTM parameters appended at redirect time. Pass an empty object to switch UTM tracking off.

name: update_link
title: Change where a link points
